about: Each gap core/parity.py finds (app:way), decided: todo (to build, with what it needs) or none (deliberately not, with why). DEC-0125. tests/test_parity.py fails on a gap missing here and on an entry whose gap is gone.

passwords:voice.why: passwords, PINs and card numbers never by voice (Zac, 2026-11-07: "keep passwords screen only")

passwords:glasses.why: secrets never on the glasses' display (with passwords:voice, Zac 2026-11-07)

sight:glasses.why: the glasses' own camera: 'what am I looking at' through them (the phone's camera works by voice since 2026-11-07)

module_browser:glasses.why: choosing apps is a bigger screen's job; on the glasses it's said to the orb (set_app_visibility, set_app_focus)

settings:glasses.why: settings are changed by voice through the orb ("be funnier", text size, contrast); no card needed on the display
